app.name: SubTrack
app.tagline: Never pay for a forgotten renewal

theme.referenceNotes: Direction: a subscription tracker for busy professionals tired of surprise charges; mood is calm control, slightly wry. Memorable element: the lavender monthly-burn ring on the dashboard, echoed by a single soft lavender glow behind the hero phone. The app UI is mostly dark Material 3 with an indigo/lavender primary (#5B4FE0, #B9B0FF), so the deck uses a deep harbour-navy base (#191C33 to #252A4A, radial) instead of near-black, letting the dark screenshots sit flush and the two light screens (analytics, onboarding) read as bright moments. Lavender is the one accent, used on three headlines only. Challenge: harbor-night plus Inter would be the default for any finance app, so the type moved to Bricolage Grotesque, which has a slightly quirky, friendly grotesque voice that suits the witty tone, paired with Figtree for sublines. Removed accessory: eyebrows cut to two slides, and decor kept to glow only (no grid). No purple-to-blue gradient. The navy stays flat and quiet.
